description: Your own instruments and equipment registered with Barmaan: name, make/model, serial, calibration due date and state (ok, due_soon within 60 days, overdue, unknown, not_applicable), service contract, and number of linked calibration certificates. Filter by q (name, serial, tag, model), category, due state, contract type, within_days (due in the next N days) or include_archived. Also returns a summary of counts. Page with next_cursor. Empty list = nothing registered yet.

cursor.description: Value of next_cursor from the previous page.

q.description: Name, serial, tag, model or manufacturer.

within_days.description: Only equipment whose calibration is due in the next N days.

name: equipment_list
title: My equipment
